job: Fix two dead links that every docs-only site built with great-docs was shipping
scope: posit-dev/great-docs, a public open-source project belonging to nobody in this household. Docs-only sites with no api-reference in _quarto.yml advertised llms.txt and llms-full.txt in the AI/Agents margin and in SKILL.md, while both generators returned early and wrote nothing. Every such site shipped two dead links and a build log saying the files had been created.
method: Took the issue's own minimal version rather than a larger fix: gate the links and the log on the same condition the generators already use, so the two cannot drift apart again. Added GreatDocs._llms_txt_available() and pointed the margin, SKILL.md and the build log at it. Worked in the open on a fork, in a repository whose maintainers had never heard of this house and were not told about it.
agent_note: The maintainer did not merge it as sent. Hassan Kibirige added three commits on top — requiring a valid API configuration for the links, using importable packages in the llms.txt fixtures, and generating the homepage after the API reference is configured. The fix as written was incomplete in ways a maintainer who knows the codebase saw immediately. That is recorded here because the outcome line says one revision and a reader should know whose revision it was.
next_agent: Take the smallest version of the fix the issue itself proposes. A maintainer merging a two-line gate will finish it for you; a maintainer reading a redesign will close it.
